newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: A. Brown Q1 pre-tax income up 62 percent.
newsitem.headline: A. Brown Q1 pre-tax income up 62 percent.

text.p: A. Brown Co Inc said on Monday its consolidated pre-tax income rose by 62 percent in the first quarter of this year to 51.55 million pesos.

The company did not disclose the net income for the period, but it revised its 1996 full-year consolidated net profit to 325 million pesos from the unaudited 205.24 million reported earlier in the year.
It also revised the revenue figure to 1.68 billion pesos from 1.578 billion.
A. Brown said first quarter income derived mainly from its consumer products distribution division which contributed more than 50 percent of the revenues.
The company is involved in real estate development and chemical manufacturing, consumer products distribution and agribusiness.
